description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

 Nightwing is seeking experienced Android Mobile Application Developers to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of high-performance Android applications. The ideal candidates will bring strong low-level programming expertise, hands-on experience with the Android NDK, and a proven ability to work across the full development lifecycle.
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and debug Android mobile applications

 Work extensively with native code using the Android NDK

 Develop and integrate C/C++ libraries within Android applications

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements and solutions

 Troubleshoot performance, stability, and compatibility issues

 Ensure applications meet quality, security, and performance standards

 Required Qualifications 
 Current TS/SCI with Poly Clearance

 Minimum three (3) years of experience developing, testing, and debugging applications using C and Python 

 Demonstrated in-depth experience with the Android NDK 

 Strong understanding of mobile application architecture and native development

 Experience working through the full software development lifecycle

 Desired Qualifications 
 Minimum three (3) years of experience developing, testing, and debugging applications using C++ or Java 

 Experience optimizing native code for performance and memory usage on Android devices

 Familiarity with Android SDK, build systems, and debugging tools

 Additional Skills (Preferred) 
 Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 Ability to work independently in a contract-based environment

 
 
 Please Note: This position is contingent upon award.
 
 Salary & Benefits
 
The salary associated with this position ($122,000-$253,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards. 
Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances.
 
 
Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.
